# KV* tools

> Open-source, read-only command-line tools for operating virtual machines on KubeVirt (Harvester / SUSE Virtualization, OpenShift Virtualization, upstream KubeVirt). Written by Florian Coulombel.

- [KVTools](https://github.com/coulof/kvtools): RVTools-style inventory and health audit for KubeVirt. Exports to Excel (13 sheets: kvInfo, kvCPU, kvMemory, kvDisk, kvPartition, kvNetwork, kvCD, kvSnapshot, kvGuestAgent, kvNode, kvStoragePool, kvHardware, kvHealth), JSON or CSV. MIT.
- [KVTop](https://github.com/coulof/kvtop): btop-style terminal monitor for KubeVirt VMs (CPU, memory, network, IOPS per VM), JSON CLI and MCP server. No Prometheus or in-cluster agent needed. MIT.
- [KVOvn-topo](https://github.com/coulof/kvovn-topo): read-only OVN topology explorer for Kube-OVN (RKE2, Harvester) and ovn-kubernetes (OpenShift). TUI and MCP server.
- [RVTools to KVTools mapping](https://kvtools.lafabrique.ai/rvtools-alternative-kubevirt/): tab-by-tab equivalence for VMware migrations.
